datasets.title: Saint Kitts and Nevis Roads (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 1.2 thousand km of roads in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 93 % of the total road length in the dataset region. The average age of data for the region is 2 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 5% of roads were added or updated in the last 6 months. Read about what this summary means : indicators , metrics This theme includes all OpenStreetMap features in this area matching ( Learn what tags means here ) : tags['highway'] IS NOT NULL Features may have these attributes: name name:en highway surface smoothness width lanes oneway bridge layer source This dataset is one of many OpenStreetMap exports on HDX . See the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team website for more information.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/hotosm_kna_roads]

lineage.description: Road network data extracted from OpenStreetMap via Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API, covering approximately 1.2 thousand km of roads with attributes including highway classification, surface type, lanes, and bridge indicators. Data completeness estimated at 93% based on AI-mapped validation, with average data age of 2 years.
